item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
Issued at 01:30 PM 20 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sibuco, Pres.ManuelA.Roxas, Manukan, JoseDalman), #Bukidnon(Pangantucan, Kalilangan, CityOfValencia, CityOfMalaybalay, Lantapan), #NorthCotabato(Alamada, Banisilan), #LanaoDelSur(Bumbaran, Wao, Tugaya, Balindong, BacolodKalawi, Kapai, Saguiaran), #LanaoDelNorte(Baloi, Pantar, Matungao), #ZamboangaCity, #DavaoOriental(Lupon), #DavaoDeOro(Maragusan and Pantukan) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Bukidnon(ImpasugOng), #LanaoDelNorte(Munai, PantaoRagat, PoonaPiagapo), #LanaoDelSur(MarawiCity, Marantao, Piagapo, Madamba and Madalum) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
